    The new R interface to Fishbase, v5.0

    Source: R/fishbase.R
    rfishbase-package.Rd

    A programmatic interface to FishBase, re-written based on an accompanying 'RESTful' API. Access tables describing over 30,000 species of fish, their biology, ecology, morphology, and more. This package also supports experimental access to SeaLifeBase data, which contains nearly 200,000 species records for all types of aquatic life not covered by FishBase.'

    A message from the FishBase team

    Thank you for using FishBase and SeaLifeBase through the rfishbase package, representing more than 35 and 20 years of efforts, respectively. With databases of such a large scope, both in terms of species and life traits covered, one cannot expect that it is complete and free of errors. We would be grateful if you could spare some of your time, to directly report to FishBase and SeaLifeBase team:

    • mistakes, typos, taxonomic issues, etc.;

    • if you have completed the dataset on your own, by sending the pdfs or reference citations that would allow us to address some missing data;

    • by sending articles that you have published using the data, pdfs or reference citations.

    Please send your comments and corrections to fishbase@q-quatics.org. You may send PDF files directly to the same address.
